import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Calendar, ChevronDown, User, MapPin, LayoutGrid, Hash, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react'; const CollectionSchedule = () => { const [day, setDay] = useState('22'); const [month, setMonth] = useState('MARCH'); const [year, setYear] = useState('2026'); const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('DAY'); const scheduleLogs = [ { id: 'SCH-1092', date: '22 MAR', time: '08:45', zone: 'NORTH_SEC', area: 'Hillside Drive', code: 'HSD-44', worker: 'RAVI_KUMAR', bins: '401, 405, 409', report: 'SENSOR_OFFLINE: BIN_405_UNREACHABLE. NEEDS MANUAL CHECK.' }, { id: 'SCH-1104', date: '22 MAR', time: '13:20', zone: 'CENTRAL_HUB', area: 'Main Square', code: 'MSQ-01', worker: 'SITA_MAHESH', bins: '101, 102', report: null }, ]; return (
{/* 🛠️ NAVIGATION ENGINE - CLEAN & RIGID */}
{/* 🌊 SCHEDULE LIST - SIMPLE & UNIQUE GRID */}
{scheduleLogs.map((log) => (
{/* TIME STRIP (LEFT) */}
{log.date}

{log.time}

#{log.id}
{/* DATA AREA (RIGHT) */}
{/* MAIN INFO */}
{log.zone} // {log.code}

{log.area}

{/* PILLS */}
{log.worker}
{log.bins}
{/* REPORT TRAY - UNIQUE INTEGRATION */}
{log.report ? ( <>

Report: {log.report}

) : ( <>

All Systems Nominal // No Deviations Detected

)}
))}
{/* 🧭 SIMPLE STATUS RIBBON */}
Active Scope: {viewMode === 'DAY' ? `${day} ${month}` : `Month of ${month}`}
); }; export default CollectionSchedule;
